claims.verbatim:
The Cunard steamship Java, Captain Moodie, which
left Liverpool at eleven o'clock on the morning of the
16th and Queenstown on the afternoon of the 17th June,
arrived at this port yesterday evening.
Her news is two days later than the telegraphic report
of the Moravian, off Father Point, and our files contain
the details of the advices by both vessels.
